text:
Priya Shah: Quick health check for OpalBay onboarding — saw p95 tail latency creep to ~420ms last 48h (goal is 300ms) and token cost +18% vs baseline. Renewal kickoff in ~6w, want to surface low-risk wins. Thinking: try int8 experiment + route docs/embedding-heavy requests to a compact model. Any objections?
Liam O'Connor: +1 to low-risk. Do we have metrics by route? are the spikes from chat or batch jobs?
Priya Shah: Mostly chat gen, but a nontrivial % of requests include long system prompts and doc lookups. I attached a quick breakdown in the dashboard.
Samir Gupta: If it's long context, int8 quant could help but watch generation quality. We could also prefix-route non-critical paths to `redwood-compact-v1` for completion-only flows.
Ella Chen: +emoji :thumbsup: Agree. For a canary: 5% traffic to quantized model + 10% of low-priority chat to compact model. Measure hallucination/ROUGE on our eval set.
Priya Shah: Can we get an ops-safe rollout plan? Need a config snippet I can hand to their SREs.
Samir Gupta: Here's a minimal rollout policy we use: ```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"path": "/chat/generate", "policy": "canary", "canary": {"pct": 5, "model": "opalbay-int8-v1"}},
    {"path": "/chat/generate", "policy": "route", "match": {"query.tags": ["low_priority"]}, "model": "redwood-compact-v1"}
  ]
}
```
Liam O'Connor: ops-bot can you schedule a quick perf smoke job for int8 vs fp16 on a sample of 500 requests from OpalBay's prod trace? @ops-bot
ops-bot: Scheduled job #38291: perf-smoke/opalbay-int8. ETA ~45m. I will post results in this thread.
Ella Chen: Also capture token-cost deltas and p99 tail behavior. If quality drop >4% on our prompt suite, auto rollback.
Samir Gupta: For the quality check run `eval-suite run --customer opalbay --suite onboarding-prompts --threshold 0.96` — that will fail if avg quality < 96%.
Priya Shah: Noted. I'll sync with their CSM and mention the canary and rollback guardrails. Need one pager to present in renewal readout. Can someone draft a short summary?
Liam O'Connor: I'll draft bullets: issue, hypothesis (long context + cost), proposed actions (int8 canary + compact routing), success metrics (p95<300ms, cost -10%, quality >=96%), timeline (canary 48-72h). Drop it here in ~1h.
Samir Gupta: ops-bot result: perf-smoke/opalbay-int8 completed — summary: int8 latency p95 -14%, cost per token -12%, eval-suite quality 97.1% on onboarding-prompts. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/38291
Priya Shah: Amazing — that's within our targets. ETA to roll to 50%?
Ella Chen: After 24h stable at 5%+ routing checks and no errors, bump to 25% for 24h, then 50% if stable. Coordinate with OpalBay SRE for traffic windows.
Priya Shah: I'll set up the schedule and customer enablement doc. Action items: Priya to run rollout with OpalBay SRE, Liam to prepare renewal slide, Samir to prepare rollback playbook, Ella to monitor eval metrics.
Liam O'Connor: Adding: capture a short customer quote on latency improvement for renewal deck.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. I'll post updates and a link to the enablement doc once live. :sparkles:
